title: WorkflowSnapshot
description: On-disk representation of the coordinare's current workflow position. Written atomically after every phase transition.

schema_version.description: Schema version. v1 is the original snapshot format; v2 (065 Fix 7b) adds per-card active_sessions; v3 (073 Fix 3) adds env_cache so env_bootstrap doesn't re-run after restart with unchanged symphony env-spec files; v4 (074) adds per-session persona_scope; v5 (075) adds per-session bounce_counter and latest_ci_gate_decision for the implementer CI gate; v6 (075 fix) adds ci_gate_rollup_signature for notify.py dedup across daemon restarts; v7 (076) adds dispatcher-dedup fields (idle_timeout_retries, pr_artefacts_recorded_at, multi_pr_divergence, wedge_count_window, reconciliation_decisions_last_startup); v8 (089) adds per-session local_fix_counter for the implementer local-test-gate self-fix budget; v9 (090) adds per-session inheritance_repair_counter and repair_audit for the baseline-repair autonomy layer; v10 (095) adds per-session env_blocked (ENV_BLOCKED infra-failure hold + notification-dedup state); v11 (096) adds top-level last_known_main_sha (the auto-rebase baseline, persisted so cross-restart main drift is detected) and per-session last_rebase_attempt (the auto-rebase anti-thrash marker); v12 (123) adds per-session content_feedback_cycles / transient_error_cycles (the split bounce budget) and assessor_open_questions (assessor Q&A carried across bounce cycles); v13 (124) adds per-symphony OpenWiki wiki-init fields on env_cache (wiki_initialized marker, wiki_attempts / wiki_exhausted circuit breaker, last_wiki_init_at/succeeded/error) — wiki_in_flight is transient and not persisted; v14 (125) adds per-session stage_verdicts (stage-verdict memory: one {head_sha, verdict, recorded_at} slot per verdict stage so dispatch can skip re-running a stage whose passing verdict covers the current PR head) and per-session processed_issue_comment_ids / last_issue_comment_id (issue-comment classification dedup surviving restarts); v15 (126) adds per-session feedback_ledger / feedback_origin_sha / noop_success_retries (terminal-success floors: feedback-item contract, origin-head reference, bounded no-op retry). Older snapshots remain readable and load with empty defaults for newer fields. v17 (165) adds PersistedSession.blueprint and .documenting_side. v18 (166) adds per-session assessment (the assessor workflow's structured product reading: goal, expected_behavior, out_of_scope, questions, assumptions, criteria with source, carried clarifications). v19 (169) adds per-session review_findings (the reviewer workflow's structured findings record: changed_files with hunks, findings with anchors, survey commands, dispositions, coverage pass outcome, verdict, and GitHub review post result). v21 (141) adds per-session last_attempt_id, last_attempt_log_path and last_attempt_failure_source for attempt telemetry restart recovery.

snapshot_at.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this snapshot was written.

phase.description: Current workflow phase at the time the snapshot was written.

active_card_id.description: Board item node ID of the active card. Null when phase is 'idle'.

active_card_title.description: Title of the active card. Null when phase is 'idle'.

active_card_column.description: Board column name (e.g. 'In Progress') at the time the snapshot was written. Null when phase is 'idle'.

pr_url.description: GitHub PR URL. Non-null in monitoring_pr, merging, relay_feedback phases.

pr_node_id.description: GitHub PR node ID. Non-null in monitoring_pr, merging, relay_feedback phases.

agent_session_id.description: Agent session identifier. Non-null in monitoring_agent and relay_feedback phases.

open_questions.description: Open questions pending team answers. Non-empty only in blocked phase.

active_card_issue_id.description: GitHub issue node ID linked to the active card. Used to post comments during blocked phase.

active_card_issue_number.description: GitHub issue number linked to the active card. Persisted so restart-from-snapshot can dispatch with issue_number set, ensuring PRs open with 'Closes #N' linkage. (045)

active_card_issue_url.description: GitHub issue URL linked to the active card. Persisted alongside issue_number for restore-from-snapshot fidelity. (045)

active_card_description.description: Active card description body. Persisted so restart-from-snapshot can dispatch with the original card context. (045)

active_card_acceptance_criteria.description: Active card acceptance criteria parsed from the issue body. Persisted so restart-from-snapshot doesn't dispatch with an empty list. (045)

performer_stage.description: Current lifecycle stage (for example: assessing, architecting, implementing). Persisted so daemon restarts resume at the active performer role instead of restarting lifecycle from stage 1.

lifecycle_sequence.description: Configured ordered performer lifecycle for the active card. Persisted with performer_stage so restart resumes the same multi-role workflow path.

card_clarifications.description: Accumulated Q&A history for the active card. Passed to the performer on dispatch.

last_blocked_notified_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last blocked notification posted. Persisted so restarts do not re-post duplicate questions.

lifecycle_completed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the performer lifecycle last completed all stages. Used by monitor_pr to filter out old reviews that were already addressed.

processed_review_ids.description: Review node IDs recorded by classify_human_feedback after staging relay feedback. Used by monitor_pr to filter already-processed reviews and prevent re-dispatch loops.

surfaced_stale_reviews.description: 128: stale-review surfacing dedup marker {review_id: head_oid} (schema v16+); records the head a stale change-request was re-requested/notified against so it fires once per situation.

active_sessions.description: Per-card durable session state (065 Fix 7b, schema_version >= 2). Keys are card IDs; values mirror the subset of CardSession fields whose loss across restart would change behaviour (most importantly performer_stage). Empty object for v1 snapshots upgraded in-memory.

surfaced_stale_reviews.description: 128: per-card stale-review surfacing dedup marker {review_id: head_oid} (schema v16+).

ci_gate_rollup_signature.description: 075 fix: dedup signature for the last CI-gate PR rollup comment (schema v6+).

local_fix_counter.description: 089: per-HEAD implementer local-test self-fix counter (schema v8+).

inheritance_repair_counter.description: 090-L3: per-HEAD INHERITED-failure repair budget counter (schema v9+).

repair_audit.description: 090-L3: append-only record of repair-gate decisions per head (schema v9+).

content_feedback_cycles.description: 123: content-driven feedback budget counter (reviewer/QA changes_requested), checked against config.max_feedback_cycles (schema v12+).

transient_error_cycles.description: 123: per-card transient/infra failure budget counter (env_blocked/system_error/unknown), separate from content_feedback_cycles (schema v12+).

assessor_open_questions.description: 123: answered assessor Q&A ({question,answer}) carried across bounce cycles, injected as prior_clarifications on assessor re-dispatch (schema v12+).

stage_verdicts.description: 125: stage-verdict memory — one slot per verdict stage (reviewing/security/qa/documenting/closing_review) recording the PR head SHA its passing verdict was issued against (schema v13+).

processed_issue_comment_ids.description: 125: per-card already-classified issue-comment IDs (bounded to the numerically largest 2000 at save), so restarts do not re-classify processed comments (schema v13+).

last_issue_comment_id.description: 125: per-card since_id fetch watermark for the issue-comment router (schema v13+).

feedback_ledger.description: 126: terminal-success-floor feedback ledger — per-item contract records, current + previous round only (schema v15+).

feedback_origin_sha.description: 126: head SHA the current feedback round was raised against; the implementer progress floor compares completions against it (schema v15+).

noop_success_retries.description: 126: bounded strengthened-re-dispatch counter for no-op implementer successes (schema v15+).

blueprint.description: 165: the architect workflow's validated blueprint plus size, blueprint_hash and created_at; source of the implementer, documenter and QA briefs. Null on v1-v16 snapshots and on the prose path.

documenting_side.description: 165: the out-of-lifecycle documenter run for the current blueprint (status, blueprint_hash, dispatched_at, session_id, head_sha, result_reason). Null when never dispatched.

assessment.description: 166: the assessor workflow's structured assessment (goal, expected_behavior, out_of_scope, questions, assumptions, criteria with source, carried clarifications, assessment_hash, created_at). Null when never assessed or cleared on re-dispatch.

env_cache.description: Per-symphony env-cache fingerprint state (073 Fix 3, schema_version >= 3). Keys are symphony names; values persist the durable subset of EnvCacheState so a coordinare restart with unchanged env-spec files does not re-trigger env_bootstrap. Transient fields (bootstrap_in_flight, pending_sha, runtime_health_failed) are intentionally omitted so a crash mid-bootstrap does not leave a stuck flag on disk. Empty object for v1/v2 snapshots.

last_known_main_sha.description: 096: the main-branch SHA the auto-rebase trigger last reconciled against (schema v11+). Persisted run-global so a main advance that occurred while the daemon was down is detected as drift on the first post-restart cycle instead of being silently re-baselined. null = unknown (pre-096 snapshots or a fresh run). A git SHA only, never a secret.
